title: Enshrouded Update Coming In Spring, Full Release Scheduled For Fall 2026
description: On January 24, 2024, Keen Games put its survival action role-playing game Enshrouded into early access. Now, to mark the impending second anniversary of its early-access release, Keen Games has announced that Enshrouded will get an update in Spring 2026 followed by the full 1.0 launch on PC and consoles in Fall 2026. In a newly- released development diary video, Enshrouded community lead François Hardy and creative director Antony Christoulakis laid out some of the changes coming to the game. The Spring 0.8 update will feature general improvements, including bug fixes and balance adjustments. The biggest addition to the game here will be "Adventure Sharing," which will let players share their world with other members of the the Enshrouded community. The Enshrouded 1.0 release will have even more refined features, including improvements for new player experiences and quest progression. Christoulakis noted that the game's combat is being retooled to give it greater tactical depth while pitting players against smarter and more varied enemies. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Unreal Engine Makes Films Look Too Much Like Games, Pirates Of The Caribbean Director Says
description: Over the last couple of years, Epic Games has made a big push into Hollywood with its Unreal Engine software. Best known as a game development engine, recent upgrades have made it a powerful tool for film and television, as seen in productions like The Mandalorian. While it has its fans, Pirates of the Caribbean director Gore Verbinski isn't one of them, likening the rise of Unreal Engine 5 in Hollywood to the "greatest slip backwards" for the moviemaking industry, resulting in films that look too much like video games. "It used to be a divide, with Unreal Engine being very good at video games, but then people started thinking maybe movies can also use Unreal for finished visual effects," Verbinski said to But Why Tho (via VGC). "So you have this sort of gaming aesthetic entering the world of cinema." As Verbinski explained, Unreal Engine 5's approach to light and its application in scenes doesn't work with films aiming for a photorealistic presentation. The filmmaker says that this tends to create an uncanny valley effect, something that human brains can pick up on very quickly when they see it in motion. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Kratos Video Game Actor Reacts To Casting Of Someone Else For The TV Show
description: Prime Video recently announced that Sons of Anarchy actor Ryan Hurst will play Kratos in the upcoming live-action TV series. Christopher Judge, who portrayed Kratos in 2018's God of War and 2022's God of War Ragnarok, has now reacted to the casting, saying Hurst is a "magnificent choice." "All I wanted for whoever was cast as Kratos was that they love, cherish, and respect Kratos as much as we all do," Judge said at Fan Expo in New Orleans. "And with Ryan Hurst, they have done that. It's a magnificent choice, not only a great actor but a great person. And a gamer who actually played God of War since its inception. So, kudos, you've got a great live-action Kratos." title: Donkey Kong Country Returns HD Gets Dixie Kong And Switch 2 Enhancements In Free Update
description: Nintendo doesn't seem to have a sensible strategy or pattern when it comes to updating old Switch games for the new Switch 2, with the latest title getting a refresh being last year's Donkey Kong Country Returns HD. The new (and free) update for the platformer adds new features for players on both Switch and Switch 2, with the most exciting being the addition of a fan-favorite character. Dixie Kong joins the vine-swinging platforming adventure, retaining her ponytail helicopter move from Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze. As in that game, she'll ride DK's back and provide an extremely useful hover, and a second player can separately control her in co-op. The update also adds a Turbo Attack mode, which amps up the game's speed for frantic time trials. Players on Switch 2 will also see improved resolution, faster loading times, and GameShare support. title: Why Expedition 33 "Ruined" This Industry Veteran's Views On Gaming
description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has "ruined" the world view of game developer Adrian Chmielarz, a gaming veteran who has been working in the business for decades. The People Can Fly co-founder who now heads up Witchfire studio The Astronauts said in an interview that the fact that Expedition 33 was developed by a core team of "newbies" is making him rethink his own work processes. He told GI.biz, "There is this old saying that 10 professional soldiers are as effective as a hundred amateurs, or even a thousand, and that's quite simply true. So when you have a small team, it's really important that you have the best people." He said he recently learned that Sandfall "hired a lot of newbies--people who didn't make a game before" when crafting Expedition 33. "And now my world view is ruined, and I don't know what to do," he said. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Fortnite Is Getting Fall Guys Basketball on Friday
description: There have been rumors for years about Fortnite getting both a basketball mode and, separately, a proper Fall Guys integration. title: Expedition 33 Is In The News Again But I Guarantee It's Not For The Reason You Think
description: Developer Sandfall Interactive's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 was one of 2025's biggest breakout hits, reaching more than 5 million in sales and winning multiple Game of the Year awards. Expedition 33 is in the news yet again this week, but it's not what you think. NASA has announced that veteran astronaut Suni Williams retired on December 27, 2025, after more than 27 years with the space agency. Williams is known for a long list of impressive accomplishments in the space frontier, including her role as Space Station Commander for Expedition 33. On this mission, Williams performed three spacewalks, including time outside the station to repair a radiator leak and to replace power components. Williams is also known for launching on Boeing's Starliner spacecraft in June 2024 for its first crewed flight. The mission did not go exactly to plan, many will recall, and Williams was stuck at the Space Station for nine months with Butch Williams, who left NASA in summer 2025. Suni and Butch caught a ride home with SpaceX in March 2025. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Hades Fans Should Know About Amazon's Upcoming Sexy Greek God Animated Series
description: Hades and Hades 2 are beloved for many reasons--they're top-tier action roguelikes with incredible combat and smart progression systems that look and sound amazing--but one of the most enduring elements of both games is their storytelling. The writers at developer Supergiant Games have nailed the unique tone of the Greek pantheon and all its bitter rivalries, tragic loves and petty squabbles, and fans of the series might be looking for other works with similar vibes. Another popular exploration of Greek myth is Rachel Smythe's webcomic Lore Olympus, which focuses on, in the author's own words, "the friendships and the lies, the gossip and the wild parties, and of course, forbidden love" of the gods. And now, Variety is reporting that an animated version of Lore Olympus is on its way, courtesy of Amazon. The series will follow the plot of the comics, which reimagines the taking of Persephone, a key story within the lore of Hades, too. While the comic's versions of many of these characters look and act quite differently from the versions in Supergiants' games, fans of the games will definitely recognise certain story elements and character beats within the series' story. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Anthem Is Technically Still Playable, But You Probably Won't Be Able To
description: Last summer, EA announced that Anthem would be shut down in January 2026, and the game's final playable date passed earlier this month. But some fans aren't ready to let go of the former live-service shooter. And one player has demonstrated that Anthem can still be played on a private server. And799 posted a video on YouTube that showed off Anthem running after its shut-down date. And799 notes that this wasn't meant to be a revival project, and it was only intended for "my research and experiment." The video's description also states that it looks like "the majority of the player data [was] handled through BioWare's server instead of Blaze, and it is required for the game to be able to load offline." Theoretically, someone could continue the work started by And799 and get Anthem playable again. However, it's unlikely that EA would simply allow that to happen. Late last year, Concord fans revived the failed live-service shooter on their own, only to receive a take-down notice from Sony shortly thereafter. EA still retains ownership of Anthem and could have any revival of the game removed just as Sony did with Concord. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: New Hytale Update Adds Dinosaurs, New Sound Effects, Easier Storage Upgrades, And More
description: Hytale may have only launched into early access mere days ago, but its first update has already been rolled out, and it's quite the big one. Hypixel, after reacquiring its game from Riot, has been hard at work listening to player feedback and implementing changes. For its first update, Hytale now has dinosaurs populating its underground jungles. While the developer states that the prehistoric mobs are a "work in progress," they seem pretty solid early iterations. Hypixel says that these new NPCs required a "change to the environment in the biome," so if you're not finding any spawning near your base, try traveling to chunks farther away that you haven't explored just yet. As well as dinosaurs, some of the biomes have had minor adjustments. The Devastated Lands sewers have atmospheric effects and creatures will spawn. Areas beneath volcanoes will use volcanic environmental effects. Feran villages have had entity placements, textures, and interiors fixed. Finally, an invisible filler block behind the bench in the Forgotten Temple has been removed. Continue Reading at GameSpot
